string.text: %c[255,0,255,0]Shroud, drop by when you're nearby — I’ve got something for you.
%c[255,255,128,128]How’s it going, radioactive meat? You’ve got one more day to get the money, otherwise you know what happens.
%c[255,255,128,128]And where’s the money you promised? Fine, you get another 12 hours. Fail this and it’s on your head!
%c[255,255,128,128]Time’s up. Your buddy has already been fed to the dogs, and you won’t be running for much longer either.
%c[255,0,255,0]Hey Shroud, still need money? I found a job that suits you. Come over, I’ll explain everything.
%c[255,0,255,0]It’s me again. I need your help, you know where to find me.
%c[255,0,255,0]Stop by anytime, I’ll always find some work for you…
%c[255,255,128,128]Well, well! Look who’s rolling into our turf! You’re on my crew’s territory, drifter. Get over here, we’ll talk. Maybe we’ll find some work for you—for the good of our boys.
%c[255,0,255,0]Shroud, I have serious work for you. Waiting.
%c[255,0,255,0]So, ready? Get over here fast, time is running.
%c[255,0,255,0]Shroud, don’t fall behind!
%c[255,0,255,0]Shroud, when you’re free, find me. We need to talk.
%c[255,0,255,0]Where did you disappear to?! Get to me right now, I’m in Rookie Village, waiting.
%c[255,0,255,0]Don’t worry, Shroud, we’ll get you out.
%c[255,255,128,128]You idiot, couldn’t handle such a simple job!
%c[255,0,255,0]Don’t fall behind, Shroud!
%c[255,0,255,0]We need to stick together!
%c[255,0,255,0]Shroud, great news. Through my connections I got the master access code to the lab. Here it is: 7200
%c[255,0,255,0]Hello, Shroud. I’m ready to accept you into our group.
%c[255,0,255,0]Where are you going? Wait!
%c[255,0,255,0]Hah! Some guide you turned out to be.
%c[255,0,255,0]Hey Shroud, heard you’re not against earning some cash. Come over, we’ll talk — maybe I’ll find a fitting job for you.
%c[255,0,255,0]Need money? Come over, I’ve found a suitable job for you.
%c[255,0,255,0]Buying any weapons in any condition for spare parts. Paying well!
%c[255,0,255,0]Shroud! We need to stick together!
%c[255,0,255,0]Shroud! Faster! Otherwise we’re dead!

%c[255,0,255,0]Shroud, how are you? Still alive? Not a word from you — no news, no trace! I’ve been informed that you’re already in the Bar. If you found something interesting… the documents from Lab X5 I asked for, bring them to the Barman. And ask him about that artifact — he has useful information.
%c[255,0,255,0]Shroud, how are you? Alive? Not a word from you — no news, no trace! I’ve already been informed from the checkpoint in the Garbage…
%c[255,0,255,0]Shroud, I’ve got a job for you, remember? Come over, we’ll talk.
5h 12m passed.
%c[255,0,255,0]Shroud, time’s up. It’s time to decide. If you’re ready — come over, we’ll talk.
%c[255,0,255,0]Shroud, the time has come. Head to the checkpoint and talk to the guard commander — he’ll brief you on what to do next.
%c[255,0,255,0]Hey stalker, want to earn some money? Come to me. I’m at the Duty base.
%c[255,0,255,0]You can go to the Arena, but be careful.
%c[255,0,255,0]You alive? Changed your mind? Before you go underground, stop by. I’ve got something for the road.
%c[255,255,128,128]Attention all fighters! The main SPEKTRUM forces are on the central square. We attack from the front. Shroud, cover the flank. That’s an order.
%c[255,255,128,128]Shroud, get closer to the APC, you’re too far. The detonator won’t work.
%c[255,255,128,128]Those bastards started up a helicopter. Shroud, run to the roof! Don’t let them escape!
%c[255,255,128,128]You let them get away!!!
%c[255,255,128,128]Attention! A combat helicopter has been spotted approaching the square. Shroud, take it down. My men will handle the evac route.
%c[255,255,128,128]Everyone, storm the House of Culture! Mercenaries and SPEKTRUM leaders are holed up there. No prisoners!
%c[255,255,128,128]Shroud, check the second floor!
%c[255,255,128,128]Shroud, check the basement!
%c[255,255,128,128]Shroud, do you have the case? Bring it to me. Move!
%c[255,255,128,128]Shroud, what the hell are you doing, you bastard? You’re dead! Attention all units — destroy the traitor!
12h 08m passed.
